statement: Given that $\tan A=\tfrac34$ and $\tan B=\tfrac12$, find $\tan(A+B)$.
solution:
Using $\tan(A+B)=\dfrac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A\tan B}$:
$$\tan(A+B)=\frac{\tfrac34+\tfrac12}{1-(\tfrac34)(\tfrac12)}=\frac{\tfrac54}{1-\tfrac38}=\frac{\tfrac54}{\tfrac58}=2.$$
So $\tan(A+B)=2$.
